=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:25186-25214 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: In `_stall_pr_ai_hold_reason`, the stall-clock backstop is skipped whenever `_stall_merge_lease_label_age_minutes` returns 2 (`[ "${_spahr_age_rc}" -ne 2 ]`), so a label-age read that keeps failing holds `merge_lease_wait` forever, with no lapse and no log line.
  WHY: rc 2 is not cached and covers failures that never recover (gh_retry returns 1 on errors it classes as permanent, scripts/gh_helpers.sh:2201-2207), so the issue is parked forever and every hold check skips it, against the linked issue's rule that "a lease bug can't park an issue forever"; the output is a `STALL_SKIP ... detail=merge_lease_wait` that looks the same as a real lease wait; severity disagreement: anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 rated it NIT, while minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash rated it MAJOR, so the highest is used.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:CI job 'shellcheck' failure | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The new code in `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh` introduces unused variables (SC2034) or other issues that cause `shellcheck` to fail in CI.
  WHY: The CI pipeline cannot complete, blocking PR merge.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:_stall_reissue_green_pr_guard | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The guard relies on `REVIEW_FINAL_CI_WORKFLOW` (defaulting to `ci.yml`) to validate CI checks.
  WHY: If the variable is set wrongly in a consumer repo or `ci.yml` is renamed, check-binding fails and the guard fails closed with `check_unavailable`, which may cause unexpected re-issue refusals in consumer repos.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "Bounded wait: when the PR has carried the label for more than `STALL_MERGE_LEASE_WAIT_MAX_MINUTES` (default `1440`), the hold lapses, logs once and falls through to today's path, so a lease bug can't park an issue forever."
  expected_change_site: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh, `_stall_pr_ai_hold_reason` — the backstop branch that decides the lease hold's upper bound.
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: `_stall_pr_ai_hold_reason` applies the stall-clock backstop only when `_spahr_age_rc != 2`, and rc-2 read errors are not cached, so a persistent read error yields a repeating `STALL_SKIP ... detail=merge_lease_wait` with no log line, no lapse and no `STALL_RECOVERY_SHOULD_INCREMENT="false"`; the bounded wait is enforced only for the labelled-age branch and the rc=1 branch.
- requirement: "Tests: ... a fixture replay of the 2026-11-21 #9398 state (labels, timeline, PR payloads) asserts no gh pr close and no issue close is issued."
  expected_change_site: tests/test_stall_reissue_green_pr_guard.py
  confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  EVIDENCE: `test_replay_2026_11_21_issue_9398_keeps_pr_9402_open` asserts no pr close and no issue close in `gh.log` only if that file exists, and it does not show that the close would have been attempted without the guard.
- requirement: "The orchestrator suite tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py (only if an existing fixture asserts the diagnostics keys) [should be updated/verified]."
  expected_change_site: tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py
  confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  EVIDENCE: CI status lists the orchestrator suite as unverified (timeout), even though `invoke_stall_judge` changed and new diagnostics keys (`linked_pr_source`, `linked_pr_candidates`) were added.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:_stall_pr_ai_hold_reason, lines 25191-25200 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: `_stall_merge_lease_label_age_minutes` returns 2 on every read failure (`... 2>/dev/null)" || return 2`), and the backstop is skipped whenever rc is 2, which also covers failures that never recover (gh_retry, scripts/gh_helpers.sh:2201-2207, returns 1 on errors it classes as permanent); the result is not cached.
  WHY: A PR that still carries `ai:merge-lease-wait` and whose read keeps failing returns `merge_lease_wait` forever, so recover_stalled_issue, the standalone ladder, invoke_stall_judge, retrigger_review and resolve_merge_conflict all skip it; stderr goes to /dev/null, so the failure is silent. Suggested fix: when rc is 2 and the stall clock is more than 4x the maximum, lapse with `label_age_minutes=read_error` and reuse the dedupe file.
- HARDENING: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:_stall_pr_ai_hold_reason, just after line 25194
  PROBLEM: When the read fails with rc 2, nothing is logged, so an operator cannot tell a broken read from a real lease wait.
  WHY: Suggested fix: print one `STALL_MERGE_LEASE_HOLD_LAPSED`-style stderr diagnostic per PR per process, deduped through `_STALL_MERGE_LEASE_LAPSE_LOG_FILE` with a `<pr>:read_error` key, and register any new prefix in the agents.d fragment (5-7 lines).
- HARDENING: agents.d/9892-stall-recovery-keeps-green-lease-waiting-prs.md:line 4
  PROBLEM: The rc 1 parenthetical leaves out the unset or malformed GITHUB_REPOSITORY case (`[[ "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY:-}" == */* ]] || return 1`).
  WHY: Suggested fix: add "or no repository" so the text matches the helper's header comment (1 line).
- HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 2

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:_stall_pr_ai_hold_reason (around lines 25186–25200 in the LAST RUN DIFF) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The rc=2 path makes the stall-clock backstop unreachable (`[ "${_spahr_age_rc}" -ne 2 ]`), so persistent read failures (rate-limit, network, auth outage) keep the `merge_lease_wait` hold for the lifetime of the stall, even past twice `STALL_MERGE_LEASE_WAIT_MAX_MINUTES`.
  WHY: This breaks "a lease bug can't park an issue forever"; no `STALL_MERGE_LEASE_HOLD_LAPSED` line is ever emitted for rc=2, and the agent.md fragment, README and changelog wrongly describe the rc=2 behaviour as bounded.
- TASK_GAP | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  Requirement: "Bounded wait: when the PR has carried the label for more than `STALL_MERGE_LEASE_WAIT_MAX_MINUTES` (default `1440`), the hold lapses, logs once and falls through to today's path, so a lease bug can't park an issue forever."
  Expected change site: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh, `_stall_pr_ai_hold_reason` — the backstop branch.
  Evidence of absence: The backstop applies only when `_spahr_age_rc != 2`, and rc-2 reads are uncached and retried every tick, which yields a repeating `STALL_SKIP ... detail=merge_lease_wait` with no lapse and no log line.
- HARDENING: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:_stall_pr_ai_hold_reason, the rc=2 branch (around lines 25186–25200 in the LAST RUN DIFF)
  PROBLEM: No diagnostic distinguishes a broken-read hold from a genuine young-label wait.
  WHY: Suggested fix: when `_spahr_age_rc == 2` and `10#${_spahr_stall_minutes}` is more than twice the maximum, emit one deduped `STALL_MERGE_LEASE_HOLD_READ_ERROR pr=<n> stall_minutes=<x> max_minutes=<y>` line through `_STALL_MERGE_LEASE_LAPSE_LOG_FILE` (~5 lines).
- HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 2

=== FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:`_stall_pr_ai_hold_reason`, the backstop condition (`if ! [[ "${_spahr_label_age}" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] && [ "${_spahr_age_rc}" -ne 2 ] ...`), together with `_stall_merge_lease_label_age_minutes`'s `return 2` paths | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: A persistent rc-2 label-age read failure keeps the `merge_lease_wait` hold forever with no diagnostic output; the last run narrowed the backstop to rc 1 only.
  WHY: rc-2 results are not cached, so each hold check in `recover_stalled_issue`, `invoke_stall_judge` and `_stall_reissue_green_pr_guard` repeats the GraphQL read, the issue never reaches the 2x-max backstop, and operators see only `merge_lease_wait`; confidence is lowered because fail-closed is a documented tradeoff to avoid repeating the #9402 wrong-close.
- HARDENING: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:`_stall_pr_ai_hold_reason`, rc-2 branch (right after the `_spahr_age_rc` capture, before the backstop `if`)
  PROBLEM: A persistent rc-2 read error keeps the hold with no observability.
  WHY: Suggested fix: when the stall clock exceeds `2 * _spahr_max`, emit one deduped `STALL_MERGE_LEASE_HOLD_READ_ERROR pr=<n> stall_minutes=<x> max_minutes=<y>` line through the `_STALL_MERGE_LEASE_LAPSE_LOG_FILE` pattern; do not lapse, and register the prefix in agents.d (~6 lines plus 2).
- HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 2
- NOTE: Reported no task gaps, saying all linked-issue deliverables are present; the per-PR cached GraphQL read is described as a justified deviation, because the `labeled` event is on the PR timeline, not the issue timeline.
